source_refs.note: Book p. 115-117: 3.8.1 Moment of Inertia: definition, Figure 17, radius of gyration, Example 66 (rod, Figure 20) and Example 67 (rectangular lamina, Figure 22).

blocks.text: Aaj ka sabaq physics se juda hai, lekin is ka asal hathyar integration hi hai. Sochiye aap ek darwaza kholte hain: agar aap handle se dhakka dein to darwaza aasani se ghoomta hai, aur agar qabze (hinge) ke paas se dhakka dein to bohat zor lagta hai. Ghoomne (rotation) mein sirf mass nahin, balke yeh bhi farq dalta hai ke mass axis se kitna door hai. Isi cheez ko moment of inertia kehte hain.

Definition: ek akele particle ki moment of inertia, jis ka mass \(m\) hai, kisi axis \(AB\) ke gird \(mr^{2}\) hai, jahan \(r\) particle se axis \(AB\) tak ka faasla hai. Agar particles \(m_1, m_2, \dots, m_n\) kisi axis se kramwar (respectively) \(r_1, r_2, \dots, r_n\) faasle par hon, to poore system ki moment of inertia yeh hai:

blocks.alt: A horizontal axis A B. Above it a particle of mass m is shown as a dot; a dotted perpendicular of length r joins the particle to the axis, with a right-angle mark at the foot.
blocks.caption: Figure 17: a particle of mass m at distance r from the axis AB (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.text_alt: m 1 r 1 squared plus m 2 r 2 squared plus and so on up to m n r n squared equals the sum from i equals 1 to n of m i r i squared

blocks.text: Aur ek rigid body (sakht jism jo shakal nahin badalta) jis mein matter lagataar (continuous) phaila ho, us ki moment of inertia yeh hai:

blocks.text_alt: the limit as delta m tends to 0 of the sum of r squared times delta m equals the integral of r squared d m

blocks.text: Yeh integral poori body par liya jata hai, yani body ka koi hissa chhoot na jaye.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Moment of inertia naapti kya hai? Mass batata hai ke kisi cheez ko seedhi line mein chalana kitna mushkil hai; moment of inertia batati hai ke use kisi axis ke gird ghumana kitna mushkil hai. Yeh mass par bhi depend karti hai aur is par bhi ke woh mass axis se kitna door hai.
\(r^{2}\) kyun? Jo particle axis se door hai woh ghoomte waqt zyada tez chalta hai, is liye us ka hissa bohat zyada ginta hai: \(r\) ko double karein to \(mr^{2}\) chaar guna ho jata hai.
Integral kyun? Rod ya plate gine chune particles nahin, balke lagataar matter hai. Hum use chhote chhote tukron \(\delta m\) mein kaatte hain, har tukre ka \(r^{2}\,\delta m\) jama karte hain, aur phir tukron ko bohat chhota karte jate hain: jama (sum) ban jata hai \(\int r^{2}\,dm\). Bilkul wahi kahani jo Riemann sum se definite integral banne mein aap dekh chuke hain.
Khud sochiye: 2 kg ka particle 3 m door ho to \(I\) kya hoga? (Jawab: \(2 \times 9 = 18\) kg m\(^2\).)

items: Agar mass \(M\) wali body ki moment of inertia kisi axis ke gird \(MR^{2}\) ho, to \(R\) ko us axis ke gird body ka radius of gyration kehte hain.
Upar wali definitions (aur kitab ke mutabiq do theorems) ki madad se bohat si doosri bodies ki moment of inertia nikali ja sakti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab point 2 mein "the following two theorems" (yani neeche diye gaye do theorems) ka zikr karti hai, lekin us ke baad koi theorem chhapa hi nahin; kitab seedha Example 66 par chali jati hai. (Mechanics ki kitabon mein yeh aam taur par parallel axes aur perpendicular axes wale theorems hote hain.) Is sabaq ki misaalon aur Exercise 3.7 mein in ki zaroorat nahin parti; sab kuch seedha \(I = \int r^{2}\,dm\) se hal hota hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Radius of gyration aasan lafzon mein: farz kijiye body ka saara mass \(M\) daba kar ek hi particle bana diya jaye. Woh particle axis se kitne faasle \(R\) par rakhein ke moment of inertia wahi rahe? Wahi \(R\) radius of gyration hai. \(I = MR^{2}\) se \(R = \sqrt{I/M}\).
Dono misaalon mein "strip method" (patti wala tareeqa) lagta hai, is ke chaar qadam yaad kar lijiye:
1. Aise chhote tukre chuniye ke ek tukre ka har point axis se taqreeban ek hi faasle par ho.
2. Tukre ka mass nikaliye: \(\delta m\) = (fi unit lambai ya fi unit area mass) \(\times\) (tukre ki lambai ya area).
3. Tukre ki moment of inertia = (faasla)\(^2 \times \delta m\), ya us shakal ka koi pehle se maloom natija.
4. Aisi limits ke saath integrate kijiye jo poori body ko cover karein.

blocks.alt: A uniform rod A B drawn as a long thin rectangle with the line A Y perpendicular to it through A. A small element P Q of width delta x is shaded at distance x from A Y.
blocks.caption: Figure 20: uniform rod AB with an element PQ of width δx at distance x from AY (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.text: Ab pehli misaal. Figure 20 ko ghor se dekhiye: rod \(AB\) leti hui hai aur line \(AY\) end \(A\) par khari hai. Rod ko \(AY\) ke gird ghumane ka tasavvur kijiye, jaise ghari ki sui apne ek sire (end) ke gird ghoomti hai. Rod ka jo hissa \(A\) ke qareeb hai woh aahista ghoomta hai aur jo \(B\) ke qareeb hai woh tez. Is liye har tukre ka hissa us ke faasle \(x\) par depend karega, aur yahi wajah hai ke humein integral ki zaroorat hai: har tukra alag faasle par hai, sab ko ek hi formula mein nahin daal sakte.

blocks.title: Example 66
blocks.problem: A uniform Rod of Length \(2a\): Find the moment of inertia of a uniform rod of length \(2a\) and mass \(M\) about a line through one end and perpendicular to the rod.
steps:
Diya gaya: ek uniform rod \(AB\), lambai \(2a\), mass \(M\); axis \(AY\) end \(A\) se guzarti hai aur rod par perpendicular (amood, 90 degree) hai (Figure 20).
Maloom karna: rod ki moment of inertia \(I\), axis \(AY\) ke gird.
Tareeqa: rod continuous matter hai, yani is mein gine chune particles nahin balke lagataar mass hai. Is liye \(\sum m_i r_i^{2}\) seedha nahin laga sakte. Hum rod ko bohat chhote tukron mein kaatenge, ek tukre ke liye \(x^{2}\,\delta m\) likhenge, aur \(x = 0\) se \(x = 2a\) tak integral se sab ko jama karenge.

Step 1: Fi unit lambai mass
\[\text{mass per unit length} = \dfrac{M}{2a}\]
Kyun: uniform ka matlab hai ke mass poori lambai par barabar phaila hua hai. Kul mass \(M\) ko kul lambai \(2a\) se divide kiya to har ek unit lambai ka mass mil gaya, bilkul jaise 10 meter kapra 500 rupay ka ho to ek meter 50 rupay ka.

Step 2: Ek chhote tukre ka mass
Ek tukra \(PQ\) lijiye jis ki lambai \(\delta x\) hai aur jo line \(AY\) se \(x\) faasle par hai.
\[\delta m = \dfrac{M}{2a}\times \delta x\]
Kyun: tukre ka mass = (fi unit lambai mass) \(\times\) (tukre ki lambai).
Dhyan dein: \(\delta m\) ko sirf \(\delta x\) likh dena ghalat hai; density se multiply zaroori hai.

Step 3: Is tukre ki moment of inertia
\[\delta I = x^{2}\,\delta m\]
\[= x^{2}\cdot \dfrac{M}{2a}\cdot \delta x\]
Kyun: tukra itna chhota hai ke us ke saare points taqreeban ek hi faasle \(x\) par hain, is liye woh ek particle ki tarah hai aur particle wala formula \(mr^{2}\) lagta hai, jahan \(r = x\).

Step 4: Saare tukre jama karein
\[I = \int_{0}^{2a} x^{2}\,\dfrac{M}{2a}\,dx\]
\[= \dfrac{M}{2a}\int_{0}^{2a} x^{2}\,dx\]
\[= \dfrac{M}{2a}\left[\dfrac{x^{3}}{3}\right]_{0}^{2a}\]
Kyun: tukre end \(A\) (\(x = 0\)) se end \(B\) (\(x = 2a\)) tak phaile hain, is liye yahi limits hain. Jab \(\delta x \to 0\) ho to jama (sum) integral ban jata hai. \(\frac{M}{2a}\) constant hai, is liye integral ke bahar aa gaya. Phir power rule: \(\int x^{2}\,dx = \frac{x^{3}}{3}\).

Step 5: Limits lagayein
\[= \dfrac{M}{2a}\left(\dfrac{(2a)^{3}}{3} - \dfrac{(0)^{3}}{3}\right)\]
\[= \dfrac{M}{2a}\left(\dfrac{8a^{3}}{3}\right)\]
\[= \dfrac{4}{3}Ma^{2}\]
Kyun: \((2a)^{3} = 8a^{3}\) (2 ka bhi cube hota hai), aur \(\frac{8a^{3}}{2a} = 4a^{2}\).
Dhyan dein: \((2a)^{3}\) ko \(2a^{3}\) likhna aam ghalti hai.

Tasdeeq:
Unit (mass)\(\times\)(lambai)\(^2\) hai, jo moment of inertia ki sahi unit hai. Agar lambai ko \(L = 2a\) likhein to \(\frac{4}{3}Ma^{2} = \frac{1}{3}ML^{2}\), jo physics ki kitabon ka mashhoor jawab hai (rod, ek end ke gird). Jawab durust hai.
blocks.answer: \(I = \dfrac{4}{3}Ma^{2}\), us line ke gird jo ek end se guzarti hai aur rod par perpendicular hai.

blocks.text: Khud sochiye: agar wahi rod apne beech (centre) ke gird ghumayi jaye to kya \(I\) barh jayegi ya kam hogi? Beech ke gird ghumane se mass axis ke zyada qareeb aa jata hai (sab se door wala hissa ab sirf \(a\) faasle par hai, \(2a\) par nahin), is liye \(I\) kam hogi. Hisaab kar ke dekhein: \(\int_{-a}^{a} x^{2}\frac{M}{2a}\,dx = \frac{1}{3}Ma^{2}\), jo \(\frac{4}{3}Ma^{2}\) ka sirf chautha hissa hai. Yahi natija agli misaal mein strip ke liye istemal hoga.

blocks.alt: Rectangle A B C D with centre O. Axis O X runs parallel to A B and O Y parallel to B C. A thin strip P Q of breadth delta x, parallel to O Y, is shaded at distance x from O.
blocks.caption: Figure 22: rectangular lamina ABCD, centre O, with a strip PQ of breadth δx at distance x from O (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.title: Example 67
blocks.problem: A Uniform Rectangular Lamina: Find the moment of inertia of a uniform rectangular lamina about a line through the centre and parallel to a side.
steps:
Diya gaya: ek uniform rectangular lamina (patli plate) \(ABCD\), jis mein \(AB = 2a\), \(BC = 2b\), mass \(M\), aur centre \(O\); axis \(OX\) centre se guzarti hai aur \(AB\) ke parallel hai (Figure 22).
Maloom karna: \(OX\) ke gird moment of inertia.
Tareeqa: lamina ko \(OX\) par perpendicular patli strips mein kaatenge. Har strip ek patli rod hai jis ka beech \(OX\) par hai, aur aisi rod ki moment of inertia humein pichli misaal se maloom ho sakti hai. Phir \(x = -a\) se \(x = a\) tak sab strips jama karenge.

Step 1: Density (fi unit area mass)
\[\dfrac{\text{Mass}}{\text{Area}} = \dfrac{M}{(2a)(2b)} = \dfrac{M}{4ab}\]
Kyun: lamina uniform hai, yani mass poore area par barabar phaila hai. Area = lambai \(\times\) chaurai \(= 2a \times 2b = 4ab\).

Step 2: Ek strip ka mass
Strip \(PQ\) lijiye jis ki chaurai (breadth) \(\delta x\) hai, jo \(OX\) par perpendicular hai aur \(O\) se \(x\) faasle par hai. Is ki lambai \(2b\) hai.
\[\delta m = \text{density}\times\text{area}\]
\[= \dfrac{M}{4ab}(2b\cdot\delta x) = \dfrac{M}{2a}\,\delta x\]
Kyun: strip ka area = lambai \(\times\) chaurai \(= 2b\,\delta x\). Phir \(\frac{2b}{4ab} = \frac{1}{2a}\), \(b\) cancel ho gaya.

Step 3: Strip ki moment of inertia, \(OX\) ke gird
\[\delta m\cdot\dfrac{b^{2}}{3} = \dfrac{M}{2a}\,\delta x\cdot\dfrac{b^{2}}{3}\]
Kyun: strip ek patli rod hai jis ki lambai \(2b\) aur mass \(\delta m\) hai, aur \(OX\) use bilkul beech se 90 degree par kaatti hai. Kitab kehti hai "by previous example". Is ka matlab samjhiye: strip ke do aadhe hisse hain, har ek ki lambai \(b\) aur mass \(\frac{\delta m}{2}\), aur har aadha apne end ke gird ghoom raha hai. Example 66 mein \(2a\) ki jagah \(b\) rakhein to har aadha \(\frac{1}{3}\cdot\frac{\delta m}{2}\cdot b^{2}\) deta hai. Dono aadhe mila kar \(\frac{\delta m\,b^{2}}{3}\).
Dhyan dein: yahan strip ke andar har point \(OX\) se alag faasle par hai, is liye seedha \(x^{2}\,\delta m\) nahin lagta.

Step 4: Saari strips jama karein
\[I = \int_{-a}^{a}\dfrac{M}{2a}\cdot\dfrac{b^{2}}{3}\,dx\]
\[= \dfrac{Mb^{2}}{6a}\int_{-a}^{a}1\,dx\]
\[= \dfrac{Mb^{2}}{6a}\,[x]_{-a}^{a}\]
Kyun: strips lamina ko left edge \(x = -a\) se right edge \(x = a\) tak dhanp leti hain. Ghor kijiye ke har strip ki moment of inertia barabar hai (us mein \(x\) nahin aata), is liye integrand sirf ek constant hai.

Step 5: Limits lagayein
\[= \dfrac{Mb^{2}}{6a}\big(a - (-a)\big)\]
\[= \dfrac{Mb^{2}}{6a}(2a) = \dfrac{1}{3}Mb^{2}\]
Kyun: \(a - (-a) = 2a\) (minus minus plus), aur \(a\) cancel ho gaya.

Tasdeeq:
Jawab mein \(a\) nahin hai. Yeh samajh mein aata hai: lamina ko \(OX\) ki seedh mein lamba karne se koi mass \(OX\) se door nahin jata, sirf \(b\) (yani \(OX\) se faasla) farq dalta hai. Double integral se seedha hisaab bhi yahi deta hai: \(\int_{-a}^{a}\int_{-b}^{b}\frac{M}{4ab}y^{2}\,dy\,dx = \frac{1}{3}Mb^{2}\).
blocks.answer: Rectangular lamina ki moment of inertia, centre se guzarti aur \(2a\) lambai wali side ke parallel line ke gird, \(\dfrac{1}{3}Mb^{2}\) hai.

blocks.text: Is misaal se ek aham sabaq milta hai: strip hamesha aisi chuniye jis ki moment of inertia aap ko pehle se maloom ho, ya jis ka har point axis se ek hi faasle par ho. Yahan strips \(OX\) par perpendicular li gayin, to har strip ek "beech se ghoomti rod" ban gayi jis ka formula humein maloom tha. Agar hum strips \(OX\) ke parallel lete (faasla \(y\) par), to har strip ka har point \(OX\) se ek hi faasle \(y\) par hota aur seedha \(y^{2}\,\delta m\) lagta; dono raaste ek hi jawab \(\frac{1}{3}Mb^{2}\) dete hain. Exam mein jo raasta aap ko aasaan lage woh chuniye, magar har qadam par "kyun" zaroor likhiye.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 22 mein side \(BC\) par, jahan axis \(OX\) us se milti hai, ek doosra \(B\) bhi chhapa hai. \(B\) sirf rectangle ka kona (corner) hai, is liye yeh izafi label misprint hai aur hamari drawing mein nahin hai. Is hisse ki figures ke number bhi 17, 20, 22, 23 chhape hain (18, 19, 21 ghayab, aur unit number 3 ke baghair).

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari practice hai, kitab ka sawal nahin. Ek uniform rod ki lambai 2 m aur mass 6 kg hai. Ek end ke gird \(I\) kya hoga?
Yahan \(2a = 2\), yani \(a = 1\). Example 66 ka formula: \(I = \frac{4}{3}Ma^{2} = \frac{4}{3}(6)(1)^{2} = 8\) kg m\(^2\).
Radius of gyration: \(R = \sqrt{I/M} = \sqrt{8/6} \approx 1.15\) m. Yani agar saara 6 kg ek jagah 1.15 m door rakh dein to ghumane mein utni hi mushkil hogi.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Particle: \(I = mr^{2}\); particles ka system: \(I = \sum m_ir_i^{2}\); continuous body: \(I = \int r^{2}\,dm\).
2. Radius of gyration: \(I = MR^{2}\), is liye \(R = \sqrt{I/M}\).
3. \(2a\) lambi rod, ek end ke gird: \(I = \frac{4}{3}Ma^{2}\). \(2b\) lambi rod, beech ke gird: \(I = \frac{1}{3}Mb^{2}\).
4. \(2a \times 2b\) lamina, centre se guzarti aur \(2a\) wali side ke parallel line ke gird: \(I = \frac{1}{3}Mb^{2}\).
5. Unit: kg m\(^2\) (mass \(\times\) lambai\(^2\)).

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(r^{2}\) ki jagah \(r\) likh dena, ya \(r\) ghalat line se naapna: \(r\) hamesha rotation ki axis se perpendicular (seedha, 90 degree wala) faasla hai.
2. \(\delta m = \delta x\) likh dena: tukre ka mass density \(\times\) lambai (ya area) hai, maslan \(\frac{M}{2a}\,\delta x\).
3. \(2a\) lambi rod ke liye limits \(0\) se \(a\) le lena: limits poori body ko cover karein, yahan \(0\) se \(2a\).
4. \((2a)^{3}\) ko \(2a^{3}\) likhna: bracket ki power andar ke har factor par lagti hai.
